title: Replay: 10 Sep 2017 storm
notes: Replay of a storm modelled on the 10 September 2017 solar particle event (X8.2 flare, NOAA S3 protons). Curves are a smooth model with the real timing, not the archived GOES record.
Crew, mission and dosimeter readings are simulated.
